policy.notes: Only jobs listed here can be dispatched by the router. The router always dispatches on default_ref; the caller cannot pick a branch. Inputs not declared under a job's inputs are rejected; fixed_inputs are always sent and cannot be overridden.

read_only.description: Token is read-only. Output is logs, step summary, and artifacts only.

writes_reports.description: May open/comment issues, publish Pages, or commit generated report/data files. No source code changes.

writes_code.description: Changes code or branches. Allowed only when the workflow opens PRs and never pushes to main. Always needs owner approval.

money.description: Touches payments, Stripe, payouts, pricing, or revenue. Never dispatchable from the router or Pages.

jobs.title: Repository scan + connectivity audit
jobs.notes: Token has issues: write. The audit_repository_connections.py step and reports/prod-connectivity-scan.json land with PR #12921.

jobs.title: Production readiness gate (goals -> gates)
jobs.notes: Runs tools/production_readiness_gate.py (report + --strict). A dedicated goals-to-gates regen step is still a draft (PR #13187).

jobs.title: Buddy 24h gap-closure research loop
jobs.notes: Sandbox-only, bounded sources. Checkpoint uploaded as an artifact.

jobs.title: Branch health scan (report only, no conflict team)
jobs.notes: resolve=false is forced. The workflow tries to commit the branch-health report files to main (continue-on-error; artifact fallback), so owner approval is required.

jobs.title: Branch conflict team (update-from-main / resolution PRs)
jobs.blocked_reason: writes_code jobs must be PR-only; this workflow also pushes report commits to main. Enable after the report step opens a PR instead.

jobs.title: Publish GitHub Pages (also refreshes Buddy control status)
jobs.notes: Publishes main to the public site. Owner only.

jobs.notes: No dedicated SLO/soak observability workflow on main (PR #9576 pending).

jobs.blocked_reason: Money tier is never dispatchable from the router or Pages.

jobs.blocked_reason: Pushes bot production profiles directly to main. Production flags are owner-only and never flipped by the router.

jobs.title: Intelligent issue cleaner
jobs.blocked_reason: Bulk-closes issues. Anything that deletes or closes in bulk is never dispatchable from the router or Pages.

jobs.title: Apply a validated Pages customization as a PR
jobs.blocked_reason: Not run directly: use /buddy customize <bot-id|division:Name|file:path> with one yaml patch; the router dispatches this job after authorization.
jobs.notes: Validates against the editable-field allowlist (buddy/fleet_runtime/customize.py), commits only config/bots/customizations.json or config/files/prospectus-overrides.json to a new branch and opens a PR. Requires the fleet runtime (#13729/#13731) on the default branch.
